artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New module: ticket mint/validate/consume, CSV formula-escaping and writer, and the export-query orchestration wrapper. Not deployed (BOUNDS: nothing deploys).
New module: the two Starlette route handlers (page GET, exchange POST) -- session check, Origin/CSRF check, the pending-login branch, and the atomic-consume-then-stream flow. Not deployed.
New static asset: the download page's HTML + its one inline script (hashed into the page response's CSP). Not deployed.

Fills the ticket_issuer call site OG-q-2 left (build_default_service now wires export.make_ticket_issuer); adds default_service() as the one process-wide singleton the MCP tools and the download routes share; adds SchwabService.export_query, re-running a ticket's stored projection with full grant/scope/catalog parity to schwab_query, unbounded within export_rows. Not deployed.

Two new Route() declarations (/schwab/download GET, /schwab/download/exchange POST) as LITERAL string paths (not a two-level module.attr reference), so tests/test_browser_oidc.py's AST route-table reader -- which resolves only one-level oauth_as./browser_oidc. attribute forms -- still parses app.server cleanly (verified: test_browser_oidc.py 7/7, test_data_entitlement_guard.py 12/12, test_principal_cutover.py 11/11, all green after this change). Not deployed.

ENTRIES ONLY (ruling 97203 C): two new ROUTE_CLASS dict lines, '/schwab/download': 'public' and '/schwab/download/exchange': 'public' -- the diff against the cut base 96ed92aa4d is exactly those two lines (probes/og_x1.py AC29). Tests are not deployed.

New file: one test per criterion OGX1-AC1..AC27, on a real moto-backed app.access_state.AccessState (the atomic conditional consume runs against real conditional-update semantics) plus tests/test_schwab_query.py's synthetic catalog/engine/fetch harness (imported, not duplicated) and a minimal Starlette app carrying only app.download_routes's two routes. Tests are not deployed.
The exact page and exchange paths this cell serves, for OG-i-3's ALB rules. Not deployed.

AC29's diff-discriminator probe: runs git diff <cut base> -- tests/test_principal_cutover.py, asserts the added lines are exactly one ROUTE_CLASS entry per DOWNLOAD_PATHS.json path and no other line. Run locally.

declared_exclusions.item: A real browser executing the page's JavaScript.
declared_exclusions.reason: BOUNDS: 'browser behaviour is exercised through the ASGI test client and by reading the static script, never a real browser or Entra.' OGX1-AC4/AC5/AC6/AC8/AC9 read the shipped script's source (history.replaceState, window.location.hash, JSON.stringify, X-Requested-With) and independently verify the server-side enforcement (Origin/CSRF, CSP hash, peek/pending JSON) it drives.

declared_exclusions.item: A resumed download after the pending-login round trip.
declared_exclusions.reason: PRD C5 asks only that a hashed pending ticket be retained while the OIDC flow completes -- hashing is one-way by construction, so the raw secret cannot be recovered after login to auto-resume the SAME ticket. The retained hash is a defensive/anti-fixation artifact, not a resumption mechanism the PRD promises; the user re-issues a download from Claude after signing in. Recorded as row NFRA_OPLGTW-W5-S8.

declared_exclusions.item: An export driven through the real spawned-child ExecutionEngine.
declared_exclusions.reason: Same convention as OG-q-2's own proof: tests call OG-q-1's job function in-process (validate_plan, check_sources, _plan_job via tests/test_schwab_query.py's Engine stand-in, extended with run_export = run_query since the fake ignores the kind split) -- the process boundary is OG-q-1's own graded property.

declared_exclusions.item: Any deploy, IAM, Terraform or AWS call.
declared_exclusions.reason: BOUNDS: 'nothing deploys.' The audit sink, policy store (moto-backed DynamoDB) and catalog/engine are in-process/local stand-ins; no live AWS endpoint was reached.

BOUNDS: 'download_original stays disabled for every profile; no route serves a Parquet or bronze object' -- OGX1-AC25 verifies no such route or string exists in this cell's code and that the contract disables the operation for every profile.

surprises: NFRA_OPLGTW-W5-S7: a two-level attribute path reference in app/server.py's new Route() declarations broke tests/test_browser_oidc.py's AST route reader (outside this cell's grant); fixed with literal string paths, re-verified green (OBSERVATION, INERT).

NFRA_OPLGTW-W5-S8: the two new routes are classed 'public' in ROUTE_CLASS -- a reasoned choice (neither consults the Bearer/ALB axes ROUTE_CLASS grades), the same reasoning ruling 97203 A gave OG-a-3's login/callback, recorded for L9 to confirm (OBSERVATION, INERT).

NFRA_OPLGTW-W5-S9: PRD C5's pending-ticket retention is read as one-way/non-resumable (a hash only, never an auto-resume mechanism), an interpretation of underspecified text recorded for L9 (OBSERVATION, INERT).
